data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for audio playback.
data.what_it_does: Allows playing audio from assets, local files, byte arrays, and remote URLs. Supports looping, volume adjustment, seeking, callbacks for duration and position, and background audio playback with lock screen and notification controls.
use_when: You need to play sound effects or one-shot audio clips.
You want to play background audio with OS metadata and notification controls on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You need robust, highly complex streaming video or multi-format playlist management.
You want a fully stream-based or reactive audio architecture.
strengths: Supports multiple audio players with memory management.
Provides background audio playback configuration and custom notification buttons.
Can load audio from assets, local files, byte arrays, and remote URLs.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration for background audio and remote URL permissions.
Limited to audio playback functionality only.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific setup for background audio (enabling audio capability in iOS Info.plist and FOREGROUND_SERVICE permissions/service configuration in Android Manifest) as well as internet permissions for remote URLs.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Feature-rich audio player supporting advanced playback, gapless looping, clipping, and precise position updates.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: Popular alternative for playing multiple simultaneous audio sources across multiple platforms.
